text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: What kind of Umamusume is Pearl-san? Are you asking that of me, a princess?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, we're in the same room, right?
Yeah, we're in the same room, right?

text_block_list.text: I decided to ask Kawakami Princess, her dorm roommate, about the true nature of Seeking the Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Well, let's see. Pearl-san is always so vibrant and full of energy, but sometimes she gets remarkably quiet. For instance...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: The other day, we were all having a game of takoyaki Russian roulette with a super spicy one mixed in. Pearl-san shouted, 'I shall never back down! Nothing is impossible!'

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And then she ate the very last one that nobody dared touch! Right after that, it was as if all that boisterous noise had been an absolute lie.
No matter how 'impossible' didn't exist for her... eating every last one meant she was guaranteed to get the super spicy one.
Was my intuition wrong after all? My assumption that Seeking the Pearl wasn't merely an eccentric jester...
Even after that, Seeking the Pearl kept acting temperamentally during mock races.

text_block_list.name: 中堅トレーナーA
text_block_list.text: Wh-What was that?! Right after start, Seeking the Pearl made massive leap toward outside rail! Didn't look like collision either?!

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Pushed out to outermost lane... Positioned dead last...

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: However! Huge mistake if you think I surrender! No surrender!

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: メジロドーベル
text_block_list.text: Wait, Pearl-san...? No way, from that position...?!

text_block_list.name: 中堅トレーナーA
text_block_list.text: Impressive how Seeking the Pearl stormed into 3rd place, but why did she jump sideways in first place?

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Side leap... Reason for that...

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Listen closely. See? You can still hear it now, right?
Closed eyes as told. Then—

text_block_list.name: お弁当屋
text_block_list.text: Bento here~, Bento here~♪ Fresh and hot~♪ Any box just 500 yen~♪

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Drawn in by that voice! Lunch box! In other words, bento is one of my favorites...!

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Fufu, race is over, let's grab lunch.
Leaving behind words unclear whether serious or joking, Seeking the Pearl departed gallantly.

text_block_list.name: 中堅トレーナーA
text_block_list.text: Hahaha... Completely unpredictable Uma Musume. Ability to close gap after starting that late is terrifying, but...

text_block_list.name: 中堅トレーナーA
text_block_list.text: Temperament is real issue. Getting distracted by bento vendor during race and leaping all way to outer rail.
That's what she claimed—but feels fishy. Never seemed like person with bento hobby.
Feels like hidden motive. Keeps saying bento, bento... Bento...
While pondering that... ended up at basement bento floor of department store on day off. Subconsciously influenced. Then—

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: My, what coincidence, Trainer who spoke to me of world. Bento your hobby too?

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Fufu, cannot miss "National Ekiben Fair". Let's chat while eating by seaside nearby!
...Turns out bento really was her hobby. Ended up enjoying strange dinner together.

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Mmm~ delicious. Japanese, Western, Chinese—jewelry box packed full of charm...

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Italian grilled lamb, French croquettes, properly customized for bento...

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: What felt here is pure "infinite possibility". Single dish, yet razor-sharp individuality never buried. Must be like this. Side dishes...

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: —And us Uma Musume, too.
Casual remark offered glimpse of true self. Seeking the Pearl really is—
choice_data_list: ……レースで横っ跳びしたのはなぜ？

text_block_list.text: Took plunge and decided to ask.

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Side leap? Ah, mock race. Already told reason, did I not?

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Drawn by bento vendor's voice.

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Fufu, tricky one, aren't you. But...

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Don't dislike it. Fine, I will tell.

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: —My thoughts. As after-meal dessert only, okay?♪
